events.continuity_hook: The workshop decision is made; the remaining choice is between a same-day arrival and a split-hotel itinerary that provides more margin before check-in.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two arrival plans using flight timing, hotel availability, transfer logistics, and complete trip cost, then identify the itinerary ready for booking.
events.scenario_brief: Priya has received approval to attend the Sunday workshop, fixing her Chicago arrival for Saturday evening or Sunday morning. Workshop check-in closes at 12:30 p.m., the conference hotel is available only from Sunday through Wednesday, and a nearby property would be needed for Saturday if she chooses the less risky evening arrival.

events.continuity_hook: Flights and the main conference stay are settled; the extra-night reservation must be corrected while its cancellation window is still open.
events.interaction_goal: Check both hotel confirmations, verify the intended checkout and check-in dates, and determine the exact correction needed to remove the overlapping night without disturbing the conference reservation.
events.scenario_brief: Priya booked a Saturday flight and one night at a separate hotel before moving to the conference property on Sunday. The first hotel confirmation shows a prepaid rate, but the reservation dates appear to include Sunday night as well, creating an overlap with the conference hotel and a possible duplicate charge.

events.continuity_hook: All reservations are active; venue transfers and document consistency are the last administrative items before submission.
events.interaction_goal: Reconcile the itinerary dates and venues, identify any name discrepancies that require correction, and produce a clean trip summary with the necessary receipts accounted for.
events.scenario_brief: The duplicate Chicago hotel night has been removed, and Priya is now assembling the final itinerary for reimbursement approval. Her workshop registration lists a different venue from the main conference, while the flight confirmation, two hotel stays, and registration receipt use slightly different versions of her name.

events.continuity_hook: The site dates are fixed, but the value of attending the Wednesday dinner and the realistic Friday airport transfer determine which flights are workable.
events.interaction_goal: Develop a flight shortlist for Wednesday arrival and Friday return, showing which outbound options permit the dinner and which return departures allow adequate transfer and airport time.
events.scenario_brief: Priya has been assigned a two-day manufacturing audit in Carlsbad beginning Thursday, September 12, with an 8:00 a.m. site arrival. She will travel from San Francisco, the opening team dinner on Wednesday is optional, and the audit is expected to end Friday at 4:30 p.m.; no ground transportation between San Diego airport and Carlsbad has been arranged.

events.continuity_hook: The daily schedule is now confirmed; both halves of the original flight shortlist need to be adjusted before purchase.
events.interaction_goal: Replace the unusable outbound options, reassess Friday departures against the new closing time and airport transfer, and select a round trip suitable for booking.
events.scenario_brief: The audit lead has made the Wednesday dinner mandatory and moved Friday's closing meeting to 3:30 p.m. at the Carlsbad site. Priya's initial outbound shortlist now arrives too late for the dinner, while the earlier close may make one additional return flight practical if road traffic is accounted for.

events.continuity_hook: Air travel is complete, and the hotel choice is the final item needed for approval and a reliable Thursday morning arrival.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the complete two-night cost, realistic morning travel time, late-arrival handling, and itemized receipt availability, then identify the strongest compliant hotel.
events.scenario_brief: With the Carlsbad flights booked, Priya needs two hotel nights near the manufacturing site. Three properties fall within the authorized amount, but their quoted totals treat parking and breakfast differently; one also requires a late-arrival notice because her Wednesday flight lands after 8:00 p.m.
